title: fix(service-automation,types,objectql): a switched-off packaged flow is refused with the same plain sentence a switched-off action reads as

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D95nzVteRYXwo88m23Tvxk2)_

Fixes #27966

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable metadata changes; only the text of an existing refusal moves

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:管理员在「设置 › 打包自动化」里关掉的打包流程,被调用时仍以 `FLOW_DISABLED` 拒绝,但提示改成一句给人看的话:「This flow is turned off for this deployment. An administrator can turn it on again under Setup › Packaged automation, or copy it there under a new name.」
- 为什么改:旧提示把系统表 `sys_metadata_activation` 和 ADR-0126 §7.2 写给终端用户看。分诊裁定复用 #27964 给动作定下的那一句,而不是再写一份。#27964 的句子是写死在 objectql 里的字符串,service-automation 运行时又不依赖 objectql,所以把这句抽成 `@objectstack/types` 里的一个构建器,动作和流程共用(席位已改认领扩面)。
- 风险与回滚:错误码、状态码、拒绝的范围都没变;动作那句逐字不变。按状态停用的流程仍是「Flow '…' is disabled」,两种原因照旧可区分。表名和 ADR 改记到一条 info 日志。回滚即还原这个 commit。
- 先看:`packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.ts`、`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`(`describeDisabledFlow`)、`src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`,预期 49 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## Measured before the change (`origin/main` 2e955dde, scratch test, not committed)

| door | `code` | `error` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| direct run (`engine.execute`, the run the REST trigger route calls) | `FLOW_DISABLED` | `Flow 'lone' is disabled — it is switched off for this installation in the packaged-metadata activation ledger (sys_metadata_activation, ADR-0126 §7.2). Re-enable the packaged flow to arm it again, or run a clone of it under a new name.` |
| subflow (a parent calling a switched-off child) | — | `Node 'call' failed: subflow 'child' failed: Flow 'child' is disabled — it is switched off … (sys_metadata_activation, ADR-0126 §7.2). …` |
| status-disabled flow (control, out of scope) | `FLOW_DISABLED` | `Flow 'obs' is disabled` |

The REST trigger door forwards `result.error` verbatim as `error.message` (pinned at `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-trigger-route-status.test.ts:285`), so it reads whatever the engine says. The retry exit in `dag-traversal.ts` asks the same `describeDisabledFlow` and is unreachable through `execute()` today (its own comment).

## Why a new builder in `@objectstack/types`

Triage ruled that the flow sentence reuse "the one builder PR #27964 settles, not a second copy". Measured: #27964's sentence is a string literal inside `ActionActivationProjection.describeDisabled()` (`packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts`), and `@objectstack/objectql` is only a devDependency of `@objectstack/service-automation`, so the flow engine cannot call it at runtime. Both packages already depend on `@objectstack/types`, so the sentence moved there as `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem('action' | 'flow')`. objectql's `describeDisabled()` now returns its action form, byte-identical to #27964's. The seat amended the claim's file surface for this.

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/types`:** new `packaged-item-turned-off.ts` with `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem`, exported from the package entry. The two kinds share one shape and differ only in the last clause: flow clone is chartered (ADR-0126 §7.2, `POST /automation/:name/clone`, offered on the Setup page), so the flow sentence offers a copy; action-clone is not (§8 item 2), so the action sentence keeps "or you can use another action".
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`:** the ledger branch of `describeDisabledFlow` (`subflow-guards.ts`) returns the flow sentence. The engine's `describeDisabledFlow` writes an `info` line naming the code, the flow, `sys_metadata_activation` and ADR-0126 §7.2 whenever it refuses a ledger-disabled flow (the #27964 log-line pattern). The status-dimension sentence is unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`:** `describeDisabled()` delegates to the builder; its existing #27842 pin is untouched and still green.
- **QA checklist:** `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable` (revision 8) — acceptance[1] and negative[3] now key on the new sentence; the verdict is unchanged (the message still separates the ledger dimension from the status one, the code is still `FLOW_DISABLED`).
- **Changeset:** patch for `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/objectql`.

## Tests

- `flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`: the four entry-path cases now pin the exact sentence; new cases pin the plain sentence (no table, no ADR) plus exactly one `FLOW_DISABLED:` info line naming the flow, the table and the ADR, and the subflow door (`Node 'call' failed: subflow 'child' failed: ` followed by the sentence, so the child is still named). The status-disabled case now asserts it never mentions Packaged automation.
- `engine.test.ts`: two toggle cases follow the new wording.
- `packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.test.ts` (new, 4): both sentences byte for byte, neither names a table, an ADR or a tracker number.
- `packages/objectql/src/action-activation.test.ts`: new pin that `describeDisabled()` IS the builder's action sentence.

<details><summary>Ablations through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs (fix committed first)</summary>

```
ABLATE-1 subflow-guards.ts: ledger branch back to the old sentence
  × the four entry-path cases, × plain-sentence + log case, × subflow-door case,
  × engine.test "should disable a flow", × "leaves a run that never dispatched WITHOUT a status"
  Tests  8 failed | 205 passed (213)    ok restored: blob == HEAD
ABLATE-2 engine.ts: log line guard -> if (false)
  × [#27966] the ledger refusal reads as plain words for the caller, and the log line keeps the ledger and the ADR
  Tests  1 failed | 48 passed (49)      ok restored: blob == HEAD
ABLATE-3 objectql action-activation.ts: describeDisabled returns its own literal
  × [#27842] the refusal sentence is plain words …, × [#27966] … not a second copy of it
  Tests  2 failed | 20 passed (22)      ok restored: blob == HEAD
```
</details>
